items.headline: D.C. Circuit blocks IRS policy used to share taxpayer addresses with ICE
items.bounded_summary: The D.C. Circuit upheld an injunction blocking the IRS data-exchange procedure used to provide taxpayer address information to ICE, finding that the procedure failed to satisfy federal tax-privacy requirements. Reuters reported that the IRS had disclosed roughly 47,000 taxpayer addresses after ICE sought information on approximately 1.28 million people.

sources.publisher: U.S. Court of Appeals for the D.C. Circuit

items.headline: ICE transfer flights surge through State College Regional Airport
items.bounded_summary: Spotlight PA documented a sharp expansion of ICE-chartered transfer flights through State College Regional Airport near Moshannon Valley Processing Center. Penn State confirmed an apparent increase in DHS/ICE-associated charter flights, while Human Rights First data cited by the outlet counted 107 ICE flights through July 2026 compared with two in all of 2025.

items.headline: Advocates report nearly 50 construction-worker arrests in Danville ICE operations
items.bounded_summary: The Philadelphia Inquirer reported that immigration advocates said at least 49 construction workers were arrested in two operations near a Geisinger Medical Center construction project, including eight arrests on September 8 and 41 on September 2. Geisinger confirmed law-enforcement activity connected to the project on September 2; ICE and DHS did not provide comment by publication time, so the arrest count remains explicitly attributed to advocates.

items.headline: Fourth Circuit rejects mandatory ICE detention without bond hearings for covered noncitizens
items.bounded_summary: The Fourth Circuit affirmed habeas relief in Lopez Garcia v. Guadian and rejected the government's newer interpretation that would subject covered noncitizens to mandatory detention without bond hearings. The ruling was a material appellate constraint on ICE detention policy within the circuit.

sources.publisher: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit

items.headline: ICE moves hundreds out of Tacoma detention center in wave of interstate transfers
items.bounded_summary: Seattle Times reporting republished by The Spokesman-Review documented an unprecedented wave of transfers from the Northwest ICE Processing Center in Tacoma, including roughly 95 people on one flight and about 400 people placed on ICE flights from Boeing Field during one week at the end of August according to county flight monitoring. Families and attorneys reported little advance notice about destinations.

items.headline: Leavenworth ICE detention center population reaches about 450 amid capacity build-out
items.bounded_summary: After a September 9 congressional site visit, Kansas public-media reporting said the Midwest Regional Reception Center in Leavenworth held about 450 detainees, up from roughly 250 in May, while construction was underway to expand usable capacity. DHS confirmed it had purchased the facility to add detention space, while not specifically confirming every construction detail described by Rep. Gwen Moore.
